instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to enable word wrap for all files.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling word wrap in VS Code editor. Similar complexity to original task but modifies editor display settings. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify editor.wordWrap is set to 'on'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks the VS Code settings file at the standard Linux location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Expected value 'editor.wordWrap': 'on' is semantically correct for enabling word wrap in VS Code
Metric check_json_settings uses appropriate strict comparison logic for JSON settings verification
Complete coverage - instruction requires only enabling word wrap, evaluator checks exactly this requirement
No postconfig needed - VS Code settings are persisted automatically when modified
Getter logic is robust with proper error handling for file retrieval from VM
No timing or state accessibility issues - settings file is immediately updated and persistently accessible

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
